definitions.explanation: A set of seven edible wild plants traditionally eaten in rice porridge on January 7th ({七草|ななくさ}の{節句|せっく}) to pray for good health in the new year. The seven herbs are: せり (water dropwort), なずな (shepherd's purse), ごぎょう (cudweed), はこべら (chickweed), ほとけのざ (henbit), すずな (turnip), and すずしろ (daikon radish).

examples.japanese: ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{七草|ななくさ}がゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat seven-herb rice porridge on January 7th.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{七草|ななくさ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought a seven-herb set at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧すぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}める→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{七草|ななくさ}がゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made seven-herb porridge to rest my stomach after overeating during New Year's.

notes:
{七草|ななくさ} usually refers specifically to the ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七草|ななくさ} (seven herbs of spring), eaten on January 7th. There is also ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七草|ななくさ} (seven flowers of autumn), but this is for viewing, not eating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {七草|ななくさ}がゆ / ⟦{七草粥|ななくさがゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧ (seven-herb rice porridge)
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七草|ななくさ} (seven herbs of spring)
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七草|ななくさ} (seven flowers of autumn)
- {七草|ななくさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧ (the seven-herb festival, January 7th)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The custom of eating {七草|ななくさ}がゆ on January 7th dates back to the Heian period
- It serves both as a prayer for health and as a way to give the stomach a rest after rich New Year's food
- Supermarkets sell pre-packaged {七草|ななくさ} sets in early January
